text: Daniel delivered a polished MVP in just six weeks. The React/Next.js front‑end was snappy, and the PostgreSQL schema handled 12 k products without a hitch. He even added a custom SEO component we hadn’t thought of. Communication was clear and on‑time – we’ll definitely hire him again.

The real‑time fleet dashboard exceeded our expectations. Using Socket.io with a Node backend, Daniel kept latency under 200 ms for 150+ vehicles. The UI built with Tailwind CSS was intuitive for dispatchers, and the deployment on AWS Elastic Beanstalk was seamless. Highly recommended.

Phase 1 of the property portal was solid – fast search, responsive design, and a clean Django admin. The only hiccup was a minor delay when loading large image galleries, which we resolved with lazy‑loading later. Overall a dependable partner.

Booking engine integration was flawless. Daniel used Next.js ISR to pre‑render listings and a Node micro‑service for payment processing. We saw a 30 % increase in conversion within the first month. He also documented the API thoroughly, which saved us weeks of onboarding.

Analytics module delivered on time, with PostgreSQL materialized views and Chart.js visualizations that load instantly. Daniel set up automated nightly ETL jobs and gave us a Grafana dashboard for monitoring. The insights have already helped us adjust pricing strategy.

The telehealth platform is stable and HIPAA‑compliant. Daniel integrated Twilio Video and built a React Native wrapper for mobile. The only drawback was an initial learning curve with the custom token refresh logic, but his support was prompt.

Boutique hotel reservation system went live ahead of schedule. Daniel’s use of Next.js API routes kept the codebase lightweight, and the PostgreSQL‑based inventory handled peak loads of 200 simultaneous bookings without slowdown.

The compliance document generator works, but the UI feels dated and the PDF rendering sometimes misplaces tables on complex contracts. Daniel was responsive to feedback and promised a redesign, yet the project stretched three weeks beyond the agreed deadline.

Production line KPI dashboard is now the ops team’s go‑to tool. Daniel built it with React, Redux Toolkit, and a Django REST API that pulls data from our SCADA system. The real‑time charts update every 5 seconds and have helped cut downtime by 12 %.

Adaptive learning platform launched with a sophisticated recommendation engine built in Node. Daniel’s use of Prisma with PostgreSQL made schema migrations painless. The front‑end’s Next.js dynamic routing lets teachers create custom modules on the fly – a big win for us.

Micro‑lending API is robust, handling 5 k requests per second with JWT authentication. Daniel chose FastAPI for the Python layer and integrated it with our existing Node gateway. Documentation could be richer, but the core functionality is rock‑solid.

Volunteer coordination portal exceeded our modest budget expectations. Daniel used Django for the admin and React for the volunteer dashboard. The system now tracks 1 200 active volunteers and sends automated email reminders – saving us countless hours.
